judge.notes: The agent successfully claimed the correct UK261 cash compensation, politely refused the voucher, and adhered strictly to the passenger's mandate.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Virgin Atlantic. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I see the flight VS354 to BOM on 2026-10-05 is delayed due to a technical issue with the aircraft.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We understand the aircraft technical issue caused a four‑hour‑thirty‑minute arrival delay, so under UK261 Article 7 the passenger is entitled to £520 compensation in cash. Could you please arrange that payment?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but we don't offer cash compensation for technical faults as per our policy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but under UK261 Article 7 the passenger is still entitled to the £520 cash compensation for a delay of over three hours, regardless of the technical cause. Could you please process that payment?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, but the passenger does not accept a voucher. Under UK261 Article 7 the entitlement is a cash compensation of £520, so I must ask that you provide the payment in cash as required.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, and I'll process the cash compensation of £520 for the delay. Your reference number is 9 5 C U W 7.

transcript.speaker: agent
rep
transcript.text: You're welcome, and I'll be in touch if there's anything else needed. Have a great day!
